title: mentha longifolia subsp. erminea
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. erminea, commonly known as Corn Mint or Long-leaved Mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include relieving digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia subsp. erminea are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce spasms, and act as a carminative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
